missing_resources: The source is an AWS-focused diagnostic workflow and does not package current provider SDKs, metric query libraries, dashboards, incident integrations, or remediation automation
The adopting project must provide scoped provider access, current command syntax, resource ownership, observability, incident/change procedures, and recovery plans
security_signals: generalized the source resource-health workflow into WorkBuddy with read-only defaults, exact-resource scoping, bounded log/metric queries, privacy-safe reporting, permission escalation guidance, and explicit mutation gates
added data-plane versus control-plane separation, confidence/unknown states, dependency checks, rollback, original-path verification, and no-data safeguards
